root.label: Talks to reopen Strait of Hormuz make progress

events.label: Talks to reopen Strait of Hormuz make progress

slots.name: Brent price
slots.sentence: The price of Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, fell more than 2 percent to about $82 a barrel on Tuesday, as markets appeared to respond to optimism about a potential deal.

slots.name: agreement status
slots.sentence: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a televised interview on Tuesday that he believed an agreement could be imminent. “We are in talks with the Iranians, and I think there is a chance we may have a deal today or tomorrow,” Mr. Bessent said on CNBC.
